_doc: GX3 pasture grass tiers (grass.cpp grassPreset; docs/ground-grass.md). density: clumps per m2 drawn within nearRadius (max 44; each clump has up to 12 cards). Beyond nearRadius the drawn share falls as (nearRadius / d)^falloff down to floor, and clumps keep fewer cards: midBlades by midRadius, farBlades by radius, where the grass has faded into the tinted ground. windRadius: vertex wind on clumps within it (0 = static; the Grass wind setting turns it off). shadowRadius: clumps within it cast sun shadows (0 = none). Read once at start-up.
